nodes.title: forgectl status: the forge cockpit (cross-project overview)
nodes.body:
Part of #1.

## `forgectl status` — the forge cockpit

### Context
A single read-only cockpit across `~/Projects` that composes the read-paths the other tracks already build — the hub's at-a-glance view of the whole workbench. "Feel the system at a glance" (Artificer).

### Scope
A TUI (and a compact non-TTY table) that aggregates per-repo:
- Git state: dirty / ahead / behind (reuse `projects.GitStatus` — `internal/projects/git.go`).
- Open PRs (the #3 read path) and stale branches (the #5 read path).
- Live tmux/cmux sessions for the repo (`internal/tmux`, #8).
- Reclaimable cruft summary (the #4 dry-run sizing).
- Board cards in flight (#12).

Drill-in actions: jump to a session, start a card, open a PR.

### Architecture fit
- New `internal/status/` aggregator calling existing ops **read-only**; no new external integrations of its own.
- bubbletea TUI; `forgectl status` verb (bare `forgectl` could surface a compact summary above the menu).
- Performance: reuse the heavy-dir prune for fast walks; fan out per-repo reads concurrently.

### Acceptance criteria
- Accurate cross-repo snapshot (git/PR/branch/session/cruft/board) that matches the individual commands.
- Refresh in place; drill-in actions launch the right thing.

### Reuse / pointers
- `internal/projects/git.go` (`GitStatus`), `internal/tmux` (tree/sessions), and the read paths of #3/#4/#5/#8/#12.

nodes.title: feat(forgectl): pr poll — auto-review daemon + LaunchAgent + tray
nodes.body:
Part of #3 (the `pr` sub-epic) · Epic #1 · umbrella cameronsjo/claude-configurations#206.

## `forgectl pr poll` — auto-review daemon (+ LaunchAgent + macOS tray)

### Scope
- `forgectl pr poll [--tray]` — on a fixed interval, discover PRs awaiting your review and **pre-stage** a review session per new PR. The human stays in the loop: the daemon only *stages*; you attach and approve.
- Stateful dedup — the reviewed store doubles as in-flight memory.
- Detached runs are **no-TTY-safe**: all narrative funnels to a log file.
- Optional **menu-bar tray** (macOS, cgo build): status + Check-now / Pause / Attach / Quit; "Attach" spawns a terminal since the GUI process has no TTY.
- `forgectl pr poll install` — register as a per-user macOS **LaunchAgent** (idempotent).

### Design (two-layer launch funnel)
Every launch entry point reaches one all-paths core function (worktree prep, reviewed-marking, no-TTY routing); interactive-only UX (a post-launch navigation prompt) lives one layer up in the CLI command — because the daemon calls the core function directly and never goes through the CLI layer.

### Depends on
- The clean-room reviewer + discovery surfaces (sibling `pr` issues), launch #2.

### Reference
cameronsjo/claude-configurations#202 → "The poll daemon", "`dx pr poll`".
